text.en: A staffing shortage is a plausible explanation, but it does not account for why the delays began so suddenly.

translations.fa: کمبود نیرو توضیح محتملیه، ولی توضیح نمی‌ده چرا تأخیرها این‌قدر ناگهانی شروع شدن.

text.en: The pattern indicates that the problem is concentrated in one region rather than spread across the system.

translations.fa: الگو نشون می‌ده مشکل در یک منطقه متمرکزه، نه اینکه در کل سیستم پخش شده باشه.

text.en: Given the timing, the likelihood of a purely seasonal explanation seems relatively low.

text.en: We should keep an alternative explanation in view until we know whether the data collection method changed.

text.en: They may have underestimated demand, although the available evidence cannot establish that with confidence.

text.en: Tentatively, I'd rank the operational explanation above the behavioral one, but only slightly.

data.title: Past deduction and speculation
data.rule_summary: Use must have, may have, might have, could have, and cannot have to infer past causes with different degrees of certainty.

explanation.fa: برای استنباط درباره علت‌های گذشته با درجات مختلف اطمینان از must have، may have، might have، could have و cannot have استفاده می‌کنیم.

examples.en: They must have underestimated the demand.
examples.fa: حتماً تقاضا را کمتر از واقع برآورد کرده‌اند.

examples.en: The figures may have been affected by seasonal changes.
examples.fa: ممکن است ارقام تحت‌تأثیر تغییرات فصلی بوده باشند.

data.title: Advanced hedging and calibration
data.rule_summary: Calibrate certainty with expressions such as arguably, broadly speaking, tends to, appears to, and cannot entirely be ruled out.

explanation.fa: در C1 میزان قطعیت را با عبارت‌هایی مثل arguably، broadly speaking، tends to، appears to و cannot entirely be ruled out دقیق تنظیم می‌کنیم.

examples.en: The change appears to have improved access, although the evidence is still limited.
examples.fa: به نظر می‌رسد این تغییر دسترسی را بهتر کرده، هرچند شواهد هنوز محدود است.

examples.en: That explanation cannot entirely be ruled out.
examples.fa: نمی‌توان آن توضیح را کاملاً منتفی دانست.

data.title: Distancing from claims
data.rule_summary: Use apparently, reportedly, according to, it would seem, and claims that to avoid presenting uncertain information as your own fact.

explanation.fa: برای اینکه اطلاعات نامطمئن را واقعیت قطعی خودمان نشان ندهیم از apparently، reportedly، according to، it would seem و claims that استفاده می‌کنیم.

examples.en: According to the review, the benefits were unevenly distributed.
examples.fa: طبق بررسی، مزایا به‌طور نابرابر توزیع شده بود.

examples.en: It would seem that the original estimate was too optimistic.
